info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizruntimedoc-List Telecom Sim Status-v3-spec
info.description: The Telecom SIM Status API provides real-time access to the status of SIM cards within a telecommunications network. This API allows users to retrieve detailed information about the current operational status of each SIM, which is essential for monitoring and managing telecommunications services. Typical consumers include network administrators and customer service representatives who need to effectively track SIM availability and performance. The API supports various query parameters to filter results based on specific criteria, enhancing operational efficiency and service quality.

get.summary: Retrieve the current status of the SIM.
get.description: This endpoint allows clients to fetch the current operational status of the SIM card, including whether it is active, inactive, or facing issues. It provides essential information for monitoring and managing SIM availability.

requestBody.description: Request to retrieve the current status of the SIM. Providing an appropriate body with the right parameters will ensure accurate and relevant information is returned based on the status of the SIM.

ListTelecomSimStatusRequest.description: A string representation indicating the status of a simulated operations request.

ListTelecomSimStatusResponse_200.title: Operation Status Response

status.description: Indicates whether the operation was successful.

referenceNumber.description: A unique reference number for the operation.

resultId.description: The identifier for the result of the operation.

state.description: The current state of the operation.

processingTimeMs.description: The time taken to process the request, in milliseconds.

message.description: A message providing further details about the operation status.

audit.description: Audit information related to the operation.

ListTelecomSimStatusResponse_200.description: The response format for the GET operation status, containing information about the operation's success and relevant metadata.

AuditInfo.title: Audit Information

createdBy.description: The username or identifier of the individual or system that created the record.

createdAt.description: The timestamp of when the record was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the operation was automated.
